response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT award_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_awards, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
